offering_description.value: Astec designs and manufactures asphalt and concrete plants and road paving equipment for contractors, materials producers and public works agencies. It also builds crushing, screening, conveying and feeding equipment for aggregate producers, mines and industrial plants. It supplies replacement parts and provides field service directly and through dealers.

primary_products.value: asphalt plants; paving and milling machines; concrete batch plants; crushing, screening and material handling equipment; replacement and wear parts

primary_services.value: plant installation and commissioning; field repair and maintenance; equipment rebuilds; operator training

customer_segment.value: B2B: road contractors, asphalt and concrete producers, quarries, mining companies and industrial plant operators; B2G: municipal public works departments and other public road agencies

end_markets.value: road construction and maintenance; concrete construction; aggregates; mining; industrial bulk materials processing

revenue_model.value: product sales: plants, mobile machinery, processing equipment and replacement parts; service fees: field service, repairs and equipment rebuilds

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds plants and machinery from steel and purchased components for contractors and materials producers; service provider: uses technicians and replacement parts to install, repair and rebuild equipment for plant and fleet operators

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe, Africa and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: asphalt production, road paving, concrete batching, aggregate processing and industrial bulk material handling

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: company sales teams serving plant buyers, contractors and industrial operators; distributors / dealers: independent heavy equipment dealers supplying machinery, parts and local service

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: OSHA workplace and machinery safety rules and EPA and state air emissions requirements relevant to asphalt plants
